name: Umbrage Focal Sanctum
core_rationale: Central smoky-quartz optics sanctuary of Umbrage Prism Atoll at [1, 1] where seven spectrum bridges converge above the Shadow Refraction Crypt.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Prismatic starlight reflection pools ringing the central smoky-quartz focal obelisk

North.lock_message: Standing indigo caustic beams across Indigo Caustic Arch blind unshielded travelers; Prism-Warden Lyra requires the Umbral Diffraction Grating before opening the northern arch.

resident_npcs.name: Prism-Warden Lyra
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Umbrage Focal Sanctum! Every spectrum bridge in the atoll converges right at my 0.58 meter smoky-quartz optics table.

resident_npcs.name: Chord-Weaver Orion
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Shadow Refraction Crypt, an eclipse-prism archon guards the Umbral Diffraction Grating needed to cross Indigo Caustic Arch!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Umbrage Prism Atoll at [1, 1] directly above Vesper's Shadow Refraction Crypt.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Smoky-quartz optics plaza where seven refracted starlight bridges converge into a harmonic focal obelisk.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m optics desks, 0.14m quartz risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Indigo Caustic Arch behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
